new_result.statement: For mutually independent cap-one X1,X2,Y1,...,Ym, arbitrary symmetric C, arbitrary rank-two M in R^{2xm}, fixed c and arbitrary measurable R(Y), S=X^T C X+2X^T(MY+c)+R(Y) satisfies sup_s E|S-s|^{-1/2} <= 2^(11/4) det(MM^T)^(-1/8).
new_result.proof_currency: 2D product-projection density cap + L2 slope density + Plancherel in two original physical hubs + half-Riesz integration

target_level_corollary: After an original nonzero scalar pivot a is completed, if its Schur residual exposes two original-coordinate hub rows with rank-two cross-slope M, then ||p_Q||inf <= 2^(11/4)|a|^(-1/2)det(MM^T)^(-1/8), retaining arbitrary other Schur curvature and affine terms.

newest_source_application.result: Theorem H applied to S0=2cX1(u^TY)+2cX2(v^TY): |phi(t)|<=min(1,4pi^2 c^-2 |t|^-2), hence ||p||inf<=4/c. The 2D product-projection density cap <=2 is used in the new proof.

partner_application.actual_inequality: For M0=c[u v] with row marginals 1/m<=1/2 and Z2=c^4, H_{1/2}(S)<=4sqrt(2e)c^-1/2; after an independent grouped square, density <=8sqrt(e)c^-1/2.

strict_n3_application.family: Q_{m,eta}=2cX1 u^TY+2cX2 v^TY+eta Y^T K_mY+(w^TW)^2, c=1+eta, K_m symmetric normalized Sylvester Hadamard
strict_n3_application.scope: 0<eta<=1/4; 2m a Sylvester size; arbitrary independent cap-one input laws
strict_n3_application.spectral_fact: at least two eigenvalues >=1, two <=-1, plus an independent eigenvalue 1
strict_n3_application.no_pivot_fact: all physical diagonals and physical 2x2 principal determinants tend to zero as m grows
